Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and presence of E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL, indicating a urinary tract infection. Mild hematuria is present. No casts or ketones detected. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
